description: Easy Chewy Sugar Cookies for the Holidays 🤍🍪 Ingredients: - 1/2 cup butter, melted - 1/2 cup sugar, plus extra for rolling - 2 large egg yolks - 1 tbsp vanilla extract - 1/2 tsp almond extract, optional - 1 cup + 3 tbsp flour - 3/4 tsp baking soda - 1/4 tsp salt Bake at 350 F for 8-10 minutes Makes 8-12 cookies I hope you enjoy this easy chewy sugar cookie recipe for the holidays!
